Sadly, Tod passed away suddenly in 1976, but his son Jerry was ready and willing to carry on the family business. Jerry and his wife Midge purchased the company shares from his mother Lucy, and they owned and operated the company very successfully for 41 years, until Jerry’s passing on October 18, 2017, leaving a legacy of achievements for Park Memorial.
Jerry grew up in the funeral profession as Park Memorial was started by his parents, Tod and Lucy Smolyk in 1941, when they got married and opened the funeral home on the same day. Serving families and ensuring that they had the best funeral experience possible was what he always strived for. It’s what he learned from his own father. He never saw things in just black and white, as he knew there were always shades of gray. Jerry always went above and beyond to help a family who was in need or was dealing with special extenuating circumstances. And regardless of the situation, he always strived to be fair, honest and ethical. He had high expectations and wanted his family and staff to always help out where they could, as he knew that positivity and kindness always comes back to us in some way, somehow. Jerry was always an advocate and champion for the funeral profession. He attended almost every single provincial, national and international convention throughout his many decades in the profession. With an incredible amount of enthusiasm and energy for the profession, he was one of the first to stand up and share his opinion, yet he was open minded and quick to let others know when they had a thought that made him reconsider his stance on things. Jerry thought that every opinion shared was worthy of thought and consideration. Some of his strongest friendships emerged from his relationships with colleagues, and their mutual support and respect for one another.
One of Jerry’s first interviews in 1975 quoted him as saying, “I love being a funeral director and I am proud to be in funeral service. I see our association as a fellowship between members…companionship, not a competition.”
This belief in his profession led Jerry to hold various positions and give of his time and energy to virtually every level within the profession. He served as chairman of the provincial school committee; served on committees for public relations, government relations and disaster services; he was a board member of the national association for 12 years, eventually becoming the president of the Funeral Service Association of Canada in 1978-79; he was a board member and president of the Alberta Funeral Services Association from 1979-80; and he was one of the founding members of the Canadian Independent Group of Funeral Homes in 1990. Jerry was also recognized by his peers for many of his professional accomplishments. He was presented the FSAC Award of Merit in 2010, which is awarded to those individuals who go above and beyond and who truly look for the greater good in funeral service… where time and time again they will put the profession in front of their own personal goals. In 2011, Jerry was presented with an Honourary Life Membership from the Alberta Funeral Service Association (AFSA). He is one of only six people to have ever been presented this award. He worked hard to earn the respect of his colleagues and it was important to him to know he earned it. Following his death in 2017, Jerry was posthumously awarded the Robert Snodgrass award in recognition of outstanding excellence in community service, contributions to AFSA, and enhancement of the funeral profession.

A Third Generation Now Leads Us
Kirstie Smolyk
Current President & Park Memorial Third Generation Owner
﻿
"I desired to see the business thrive, and to see our family heritage of caring for bereaved families continue."
Currently in its third generation into the company's management, Kirstie Smolyk, Tod's granddaughter and Jerry's daughter, continues the funeral tradition of the Smolyk family as president of Park Memorial. She has been leading the organization for well over a decade. Park Memorial truly walks forward as a family business, as Kirstie’s mother Midge, sister Lindy, and husband Nelson are all involved in day-to-day operations.
Kirstie shares her journey into her role in the family business: “I grew up in the funeral profession, so it was an easy tie-in. I grew up colouring under my dad’s desk, playing in the staff room, and it was what I knew. I worked at the funeral home all through university but wasn’t sure what I really wanted to do with my career.
I thought I wanted to be in marketing, and my dad, who was president at the time, agreed and saw the value of my pursuit of different opportunities, learning from other industries and professionals. A few years later, I came to a crossroads in my career, and we went for a ‘Daddy / Daughter’ lunch. He recognized the breadth of experience that I had acquired in my time away from funeral service and invited me back. It was the right time, and I accepted. I desired to see the business thrive, and to see our family heritage of caring for bereaved families continue. I also better understood the flexibility that comes with leading a family-owned business.” Steadfast in her desire to see the legacy of her grandfather and her father thrive under her leadership, Kirstie is a force of kindness, compassion, and community development.

About Park Memorial

OUR HERITAGE    |    MEET OUR TEAM    |    LOCATIONS    |    CAREERS    |    CONTACT US

An 80-year-old family-owned and operated funeral home,

devoted to serving your family with care and compassion.

Park Memorial Ltd. is a family owned and operated funeral home with over 80 years of experience serving families from our locations throughout northern Alberta, including Edmonton, Vegreville, Mayerthorpe, Lamont, and Smoky Lake. We offer a complete selection of traditional and contemporary burial and cremation services and we are proud to honour all cultural and faith-based customs and traditions. Our funeral planning team is among the finest in the profession and their caring attention to detail makes a very difficult and emotional time easier for families.

OUR HERITAGE

The Building of a Dream and a Family

Tod Smolyk started out in 1941 as a funeral director with a dream. He had his own embalming instruments and 12 friends who had each contributed $100 to help him start his company. One of the doors he knocked on introduced Tod to Lucy Kostynuk, who ended up becoming the funeral home’s largest investor. To be able to contribute his share, Tod had to donate his embalming instruments to the company at their appraised value. The courtship of Tod and Lucy turned into an engagement, and the rest was history.

Tod and his fiancée, Lucy, were married at 3 p.m. on November 29, 1941. Instead of heading out to enjoy a honeymoon, they opened the doors to their new funeral home at 6 p.m. that same evening. Park Memorial's first hearse was a 1941 Ford panel truck that was converted locally, and the first car used to chauffeur families was a used Studebaker sedan. A Growing Network of Care

As business improved, the company expanded to communities outside of Edmonton. The Vegreville branch was purchased in 1943, the Lamont branch in 1946, the Vilna branch in 1951, the Wildwood and Mayerthorpe branches in 1955, and the Smoky Lake branch in 1956. The present Edmonton building is not the original. The former building was sold and moved off the property and the current building was built in 1963 on the original site of Park Memorial at the corner of 97 Street and 111 Avenue.

The current building was actually built right around the original as it was located on the space that is our front (north) parking lot today. The size of the original 1941 building was much smaller and would have fit entirely in the space occupied by our present chapel.

A Second Generation of Leadership

Jerry Smolyk (In Memorium) & Midge Smolyk

Former President and Second Generation Family Owners

"I love being a funeral director and I am proud to be in funeral service. I see our association

﻿as a fellowship between members. Companionship, not a competition." – Jerry Smolyk

Sadly, Tod passed away suddenly in 1976, but his son Jerry was ready and willing to carry on the family business. Jerry and his wife Midge purchased the company shares from his mother Lucy, and they owned and operated the company very successfully for 41 years, until Jerry’s passing on October 18, 2017, leaving a legacy of achievements for Park Memorial.


Jerry grew up in the funeral profession as Park Memorial was started by his parents, Tod and Lucy Smolyk in 1941, when they got married and opened the funeral home on the same day. Serving families and ensuring that they had the best funeral experience possible was what he always strived for. It’s what he learned from his own father. He never saw things in just black and white, as he knew there were always shades of gray. Jerry always went above and beyond to help a family who was in need or was dealing with special extenuating circumstances. And regardless of the situation, he always strived to be fair, honest and ethical. He had high expectations and wanted his family and staff to always help out where they could, as he knew that positivity and kindness always comes back to us in some way, somehow. Jerry was always an advocate and champion for the funeral profession. He attended almost every single provincial, national and international convention throughout his many decades in the profession. With an incredible amount of enthusiasm and energy for the profession, he was one of the first to stand up and share his opinion, yet he was open minded and quick to let others know when they had a thought that made him reconsider his stance on things. Jerry thought that every opinion shared was worthy of thought and consideration. Some of his strongest friendships emerged from his relationships with colleagues, and their mutual support and respect for one another.

One of Jerry’s first interviews in 1975 quoted him as saying, “I love being a funeral director and I am proud to be in funeral service. I see our association as a fellowship between members…companionship, not a competition.”


This belief in his profession led Jerry to hold various positions and give of his time and energy to virtually every level within the profession. He served as chairman of the provincial school committee; served on committees for public relations, government relations and disaster services; he was a board member of the national association for 12 years, eventually becoming the president of the Funeral Service Association of Canada in 1978-79; he was a board member and president of the Alberta Funeral Services Association from 1979-80; and he was one of the founding members of the Canadian Independent Group of Funeral Homes in 1990. Jerry was also recognized by his peers for many of his professional accomplishments. He was presented the FSAC Award of Merit in 2010, which is awarded to those individuals who go above and beyond and who truly look for the greater good in funeral service… where time and time again they will put the profession in front of their own personal goals. In 2011, Jerry was presented with an Honourary Life Membership from the Alberta Funeral Service Association (AFSA). He is one of only six people to have ever been presented this award. He worked hard to earn the respect of his colleagues and it was important to him to know he earned it. Following his death in 2017, Jerry was posthumously awarded the Robert Snodgrass award in recognition of outstanding excellence in community service, contributions to AFSA, and enhancement of the funeral profession.

A Third Generation Now Leads Us

Kirstie Smolyk

Current President & Park Memorial Third Generation Owner﻿

"I desired to see the business thrive, and to see our family heritage of caring for bereaved families continue."

Currently in its third generation into the company's management, Kirstie Smolyk, Tod's granddaughter and Jerry's daughter, continues the funeral tradition of the Smolyk family as president of Park Memorial. She has been leading the organization for well over a decade. Park Memorial truly walks forward as a family business, as Kirstie’s mother Midge, sister Lindy, and husband Nelson are all involved in day-to-day operations.


Kirstie shares her journey into her role in the family business: “I grew up in the funeral profession, so it was an easy tie-in. I grew up colouring under my dad’s desk, playing in the staff room, and it was what I knew. I worked at the funeral home all through university but wasn’t sure what I really wanted to do with my career.

I thought I wanted to be in marketing, and my dad, who was president at the time, agreed and saw the value of my pursuit of different opportunities, learning from other industries and professionals. A few years later, I came to a crossroads in my career, and we went for a ‘Daddy / Daughter’ lunch. He recognized the breadth of experience that I had acquired in my time away from funeral service and invited me back. It was the right time, and I accepted. I desired to see the business thrive, and to see our family heritage of caring for bereaved families continue. I also better understood the flexibility that comes with leading a family-owned business.” Steadfast in her desire to see the legacy of her grandfather and her father thrive under her leadership, Kirstie is a force of kindness, compassion, and community development.

She answered our questions in an extremely timely manner and made us feel like we were the only clients she had. 17 months after the funeral we reached out to Alexandra to help us get some programs printed for the Celebration of Life. It was a Saturday evening, and since I knew of your Funeral home, I called it. OUR HERITAGE
The Building of a Dream and a Family
Tod Smolyk started out in 1941 as a funeral director with a dream. He had his own embalming instruments and 12 friends who had each contributed $100 to help him start his company. One of the doors he knocked on introduced Tod to Lucy Kostynuk, who ended up becoming the funeral home’s largest investor. To be able to contribute his share, Tod had to donate his embalming instruments to the company at their appraised value. The courtship of Tod and Lucy turned into an engagement, and the rest was history.
Tod and his fiancée, Lucy, were married at 3 p.m. on November 29, 1941. Instead of heading out to enjoy a honeymoon, they opened the doors to their new funeral home at 6 p.m. that same evening. Park Memorial's first hearse was a 1941 Ford panel truck that was converted locally, and the first car used to chauffeur families was a used Studebaker sedan. Click
here
to learn more about our first steps as a family company.

A Growing Network of Care
As business improved, the company expanded to communities outside of Edmonton. The Vegreville branch was purchased in 1943, the Lamont branch in 1946, the Vilna branch in 1951, the Wildwood and Mayerthorpe branches in 1955, and the Smoky Lake branch in 1956. The present Edmonton building is not the original. The former building was sold and moved off the property and the current building was built in 1963 on the original site of Park Memorial at the corner of 97 Street and 111 Avenue.
The current building was actually built right around the original as it was located on the space that is our front (north) parking lot today. The size of the original 1941 building was much smaller and would have fit entirely in the space occupied by our present chapel.
A Second Generation of Leadership
Jerry Smolyk (In Memorium) & Midge Smolyk
Former President and Second Generation Family Owners
"I love being a funeral director and I am proud to be in funeral service. I see our association
﻿
as a fellowship between members. Companionship, not a competition." – Jerry Smolyk
Sadly, Tod passed away suddenly in 1976, but his son Jerry was ready and willing to carry on the family business. Jerry and his wife Midge purchased the company shares from his mother Lucy, and they owned and operated the company very successfully for 41 years, until Jerry’s passing on October 18, 2017, leaving a legacy of achievements for Park Memorial.
Jerry grew up in the funeral profession as Park Memorial was started by his parents, Tod and Lucy Smolyk in 1941, when they got married and opened the funeral home on the same day. Serving families and ensuring that they had the best funeral experience possible was what he always strived for. It’s what he learned from his own father. He never saw things in just black and white, as he knew there were always shades of gray. Jerry always went above and beyond to help a family who was in need or was dealing with special extenuating circumstances. And regardless of the situation, he always strived to be fair, honest and ethical. He had high expectations and wanted his family and staff to always help out where they could, as he knew that positivity and kindness always comes back to us in some way, somehow. Jerry was always an advocate and champion for the funeral profession. He attended almost every single provincial, national and international convention throughout his many decades in the profession. With an incredible amount of enthusiasm and energy for the profession, he was one of the first to stand up and share his opinion, yet he was open minded and quick to let others know when they had a thought that made him reconsider his stance on things. Jerry thought that every opinion shared was worthy of thought and consideration. Some of his strongest friendships emerged from his relationships with colleagues, and their mutual support and respect for one another.
One of Jerry’s first interviews in 1975 quoted him as saying, “I love being a funeral director and I am proud to be in funeral service. I see our association as a fellowship between members…companionship, not a competition.”
This belief in his profession led Jerry to hold various positions and give of his time and energy to virtually every level within the profession. He served as chairman of the provincial school committee; served on committees for public relations, government relations and disaster services; he was a board member of the national association for 12 years, eventually becoming the president of the Funeral Service Association of Canada in 1978-79; he was a board member and president of the Alberta Funeral Services Association from 1979-80; and he was one of the founding members of the Canadian Independent Group of Funeral Homes in 1990. Jerry was also recognized by his peers for many of his professional accomplishments. He was presented the FSAC Award of Merit in 2010, which is awarded to those individuals who go above and beyond and who truly look for the greater good in funeral service… where time and time again they will put the profession in front of their own personal goals. In 2011, Jerry was presented with an Honourary Life Membership from the Alberta Funeral Service Association (AFSA). He is one of only six people to have ever been presented this award. He worked hard to earn the respect of his colleagues and it was important to him to know he earned it. Following his death in 2017, Jerry was posthumously awarded the Robert Snodgrass award in recognition of outstanding excellence in community service, contributions to AFSA, and enhancement of the funeral profession.

A Third Generation Now Leads Us
Kirstie Smolyk
Current President & Park Memorial Third Generation Owner
﻿
"I desired to see the business thrive, and to see our family heritage of caring for bereaved families continue."
Currently in its third generation into the company's management, Kirstie Smolyk, Tod's granddaughter and Jerry's daughter, continues the funeral tradition of the Smolyk family as president of Park Memorial. She has been leading the organization for well over a decade. Park Memorial truly walks forward as a family business, as Kirstie’s mother Midge, sister Lindy, and husband Nelson are all involved in day-to-day operations.
Kirstie shares her journey into her role in the family business: “I grew up in the funeral profession, so it was an easy tie-in. I grew up colouring under my dad’s desk, playing in the staff room, and it was what I knew. I worked at the funeral home all through university but wasn’t sure what I really wanted to do with my career.
I thought I wanted to be in marketing, and my dad, who was president at the time, agreed and saw the value of my pursuit of different opportunities, learning from other industries and professionals. A few years later, I came to a crossroads in my career, and we went for a ‘Daddy / Daughter’ lunch. He recognized the breadth of experience that I had acquired in my time away from funeral service and invited me back. It was the right time, and I accepted. I desired to see the business thrive, and to see our family heritage of caring for bereaved families continue. I also better understood the flexibility that comes with leading a family-owned business.” Steadfast in her desire to see the legacy of her grandfather and her father thrive under her leadership, Kirstie is a force of kindness, compassion, and community development.

Burial / Entombment Services
A long-standing tradition, burial is a method of final disposition whereby your loved one is laid to rest in a casket, which is then buried in a cemetery or entombed in a mausoleum.
There are some steps you will need to go through if burial (also referred to as interment) is the choice of final rest for your loved one, or when you personally select burial during your own funeral preplanning . One of the first choices you must make is to choose both the cemetery and a precise place of burial within its grounds or the placement of a crypt in a mausoleum.
After that, you must choose a casket and burial vault as required. Your funeral director will be able to tell you if your cemetery requires the use of a burial vault. The next step will be choosing a grave monument or crypt plaque and composing its inscription.
FUNERAL PRODUCTS
CALL US NOW (TOLL FREE): 1-877-426-0050
One of Alberta's most referred and respected funeral planners.
Park Memorial has over 80 years of experience serving families at our Edmonton funeral home and our four other locations throughout Northern Alberta. Depending on your personal and cultural preferences, religious requirements, and financial budget, we can offer a variety of products and ceremonies ranging from simple and traditional to contemporary and modern. Every service can be personalized to pay tribute to the life and personality of your loved one.
We pride ourselves on being able to customize and personalize every detail of each funeral service to provide something meaningful and unique. Please check our other services below:

One of the first choices you must make is to choose both the cemetery and a precise place of burial within its grounds or the placement of a crypt in a mausoleum.
After that, you must choose a casket and burial vault as required. Your funeral director will be able to tell you if your cemetery requires the use of a burial vault. The next step will be choosing a grave monument or crypt plaque and composing its inscription.
FUNERAL PRODUCTS

One of Alberta's most referred and respected funeral planners.
Park Memorial has over 80 years of experience serving families at our Edmonton funeral home and our four other locations throughout Northern Alberta. Depending on your personal and cultural preferences, religious requirements, and financial budget, we can offer a variety of products and ceremonies ranging from simple and traditional to contemporary and modern. Every service can be personalized to pay tribute to the life and personality of your loved one.
We pride ourselves on being able to customize and personalize every detail of each funeral service to provide something meaningful and unique. Please check our other services below:

We also offer funeral pre-planning and carry a wide selection of caskets, vaults, urns and burial containers.

ABOUT US
About Us
As a part of our community, we care deeply for the families we serve. From preplanning funerals through the process of carrying it out and following up with family after the service is over, we’ll be there.
We will walk closely beside you when you need us, and remain within reach whenever the time may call.
About Pierson's
The Pierson family has been serving Calgarians for over 40 years, with a reputation built on superior service at a fair and moderate price. In a day of large funeral home conglomerates, Pierson’s continues to be a family owned and professionally operated business. Calgary Herald was kind enough to feature our story. Read more about our family-owned business

Our staff is comprised of dedicated and licensed professionals with the experience to answer all your questions regarding our services. Please feel free to contact any of our staff members at any time.
Michael J. Pierson
President, Pierson’s Funeral Service
Michael Pierson was born and raised in Calgary. He was one of the seven Pierson children to attend Viscount Bennett Jr. & Sr. High Schools. He then attended Brigham Young University in Provo, Utah where he studied Music and Business. In 1986 he transferred to the Cincinnati College of Mortuary Science at Xavier University in Cincinnati, Ohio and graduated with a Bachelors of Mortuary Science (cum laud) in 1987. He had training and experience in funeral homes in Utah and Ohio while attending University prior to returning to Calgary in 1988 to join the family firm. Michael has always shown leadership characteristics as well as being community and service minded. In High School he served as Class President and more recently served as the President of the International Avenue Business Revitalization Zone, an organization which has done significant work to improve the business district in the Forest Lawn area of Calgary. Michael also served on the Executive Council of the Alberta Funeral Service Association for eight years including a term as President. Michael is past Chairman of the International Avenue Arts and Culture Centre. Michael has an active Church life and loves to spend time with his wife Kathleen and their sons Eric and Connor. Michael has a passion for his work at the funeral home. He loves helping families who need our services and is proud of the good reputation and business the family has built.

David Root

He was exposed to the family business from an early age and is proud to continue the family business into another generation. David graduated from Lester B. David is still actively involved with The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. He has also volunteered with the Calgary Stampede Parade Committee since he was a teenager and has been an official volunteer since 2009. David’s official work with Pierson’s started in 2005 and he currently serves as our General Manager as well as a licensed funeral director and embalmer. David’s love for the profession has led him to return to Mount Royal University as an instructor for the Funeral Services Program. He has also been an active member of the Alberta Funeral Service Association and is currently serving as a Director on the Board.

OUR STAFF

Meet Our Caring Staff

AVAILABLE 24/7, CALL US: 403-235-3602

Our staff is comprised of dedicated and licensed professionals with the experience to answer all your questions regarding our services. Please feel free to contact any of our staff members at any time.

Michael J. Pierson

President, Pierson’s Funeral Service

Michael Pierson was born and raised in Calgary. He was one of the seven Pierson children to attend Viscount Bennett Jr. & Sr. High Schools. He then attended Brigham Young University in Provo, Utah where he studied Music and Business. In 1986 he transferred to the Cincinnati College of Mortuary Science at Xavier University in Cincinnati, Ohio and graduated with a Bachelors of Mortuary Science (cum laud) in 1987. He had training and experience in funeral homes in Utah and Ohio while attending University prior to returning to Calgary in 1988 to join the family firm. Michael has always shown leadership characteristics as well as being community and service minded. In High School he served as Class President and more recently served as the President of the International Avenue Business Revitalization Zone, an organization which has done significant work to improve the business district in the Forest Lawn area of Calgary. Michael also served on the Executive Council of the Alberta Funeral Service Association for eight years including a term as President. Michael is past Chairman of the International Avenue Arts and Culture Centre. Michael has an active Church life and loves to spend time with his wife Kathleen and their sons Eric and Connor. Michael has a passion for his work at the funeral home. He loves helping families who need our services and is proud of the good reputation and business the family has built.

David Root

General Manager, Pierson’s Funeral Service

David is a grandson to the founders of Pierson’s Funeral Service, Ches & Joan Pierson. He was exposed to the family business from an early age and is proud to continue the family business into another generation. David graduated from Lester B. Pearson High School and then served a mission for The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints in Southern California. Upon returning from his mission he attended Mount Royal University. In 2005 he married his wife Marysol and they now have four children. Although his first intentions in school were in another direction, he joined the family business and quickly recognized his love for funeral service and changed programs, graduating with a General Arts & Sciences Certificate as well as a Funeral Director and Embalmer Extension Certificate. David is still actively involved with The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. He has also volunteered with the Calgary Stampede Parade Committee since he was a teenager and has been an official volunteer since 2009. David’s official work with Pierson’s started in 2005 and he currently serves as our General Manager as well as a licensed funeral director and embalmer. David’s love for the profession has led him to return to Mount Royal University as an instructor for the Funeral Services Program. He has also been an active member of the Alberta Funeral Service Association and is currently serving as a Director on the Board.

Our staff is comprised of dedicated and licensed professionals with the experience to answer all your questions regarding our services. Please feel free to contact any of our staff members at any time.
Michael J. Pierson
President, Pierson’s Funeral Service
Michael Pierson was born and raised in Calgary. He was one of the seven Pierson children to attend Viscount Bennett Jr. & Sr. High Schools. He then attended Brigham Young University in Provo, Utah where he studied Music and Business. In 1986 he transferred to the Cincinnati College of Mortuary Science at Xavier University in Cincinnati, Ohio and graduated with a Bachelors of Mortuary Science (cum laud) in 1987. He had training and experience in funeral homes in Utah and Ohio while attending University prior to returning to Calgary in 1988 to join the family firm. Michael has always shown leadership characteristics as well as being community and service minded. In High School he served as Class President and more recently served as the President of the International Avenue Business Revitalization Zone, an organization which has done significant work to improve the business district in the Forest Lawn area of Calgary. Michael also served on the Executive Council of the Alberta Funeral Service Association for eight years including a term as President. Michael is past Chairman of the International Avenue Arts and Culture Centre. Michael has an active Church life and loves to spend time with his wife Kathleen and their sons Eric and Connor. Michael has a passion for his work at the funeral home. He loves helping families who need our services and is proud of the good reputation and business the family has built.

David Root
General Manager, Pierson’s Funeral Service
David is a grandson to the founders of Pierson’s Funeral Service, Ches & Joan Pierson. He was exposed to the family business from an early age and is proud to continue the family business into another generation. David graduated from Lester B. Pearson High School and then served a mission for The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints in Southern California. Upon returning from his mission he attended Mount Royal University. In 2005 he married his wife Marysol and they now have four children. Although his first intentions in school were in another direction, he joined the family business and quickly recognized his love for funeral service and changed programs, graduating with a General Arts & Sciences Certificate as well as a Funeral Director and Embalmer Extension Certificate. David is still actively involved with The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. He has also volunteered with the Calgary Stampede Parade Committee since he was a teenager and has been an official volunteer since 2009. David’s official work with Pierson’s started in 2005 and he currently serves as our General Manager as well as a licensed funeral director and embalmer. David’s love for the profession has led him to return to Mount Royal University as an instructor for the Funeral Services Program. He has also been an active member of the Alberta Funeral Service Association and is currently serving as a Director on the Board.

David was raised on a farm in the surrounding area of Legal, Alberta. He is married to Valerie (nee Dudra). Together they have two children, Lisa and Christopher, and one grandson Chase.
In 1982 David commenced funeral service with Howard & McBride Funeral Home in Edmonton under the direction of Luke LaFrance. Since then, he was given the opportunity to travel across the prairie provinces serving families compassionately. David received his diplomas for being a funeral director and embalmer through the Alberta School of Mortuary Science, Saskatchewan Funeral Service Association, and the Manitoba Funeral Service Association.
David believed in continuing education, and through the years he attained three management designations through the University of Alberta and the Canadian Institute of Management.
David moved to Calgary in 2002 and joined the team of professionals at Pierson’s Funeral Service Limited. After a few years, he stepped away from Pierson’s only to return to join the Pierson family in serving the citizens of Calgary.
David attends St. Stephen Protomartyr Ukrainian Catholic Church and has served as president of the parish council. His faith has carried him through numerous other volunteer positions with the Ukrainian community.
David’s other passion is working with the Knights of Columbus. He is a member and actively involved with the St. Nicholas Byzantine Ukrainian Knights of Columbus Council #7659 and the St. Stephen’s Knights of Columbus Fourth Degree Assembly #2522. He has held various positions at the council level, and at the State level.
David has been passionately serving the Catholic community, and other communities abroad for over 40 years.

As an involved mother she spends much time with her family and driving kids to their activities. She loves reading, watching documentaries and in her younger years participated in a lot of indoor and outdoor rock climbing.
Teresa lives by the mantra of everything in moderation. She is motivated by giving families what they want and something they didn’t know they needed. We appreciate her calm, dedicated, professional demeanor.

Everyone who knows Bridget is aware that her favourite topic outside of funeral service is hockey. She learned great lessons from playing and coaching ice hockey at an elite level.

Welcome to Robert ANderson Funeral Services Inc.
Service From The Heart
Robert Anderson Funeral Services Inc. is proud to offer friends and families complete funeral and memorial services under one  roof in the Regional Municipality of Wood Buffalo.   For years, we’ve helped the community navigate the complex decisions and emotions that follow the death of a loved one. Our staff is caring, committed and graced with the resources to arrange a day perfectly designed to commemorate the life and legacy of your loved one. Robert Anderson Funeral Services Inc. is wheelchair accessible and located just minutes from the Fort McMurray International Airport; an ideal location for visitors to the area.
Please feel free to browse our pages to learn more about pre-planning a funeral and grief support, as well as the traditional funeral and cremation services that we offer. If you have any questions or concerns, please  contact us anytime. Drop by the office as needed, or contact us via phone or e-mail. We are always here for you.
Furthermore, we understand that it is not always possible to attend a service or a visitation in person. In light of this, we've created beautiful interactive online tributes to memorialize your loved one and now offer streaming services via Facebook Live or Zoom. You may also leave a condolence, share a memory, post a photo, light a candle, and more!
Robert Anderson Funeral Services Inc is pleased to now offer the following services
Pre-Arrangements and Payment Options
We are now licensed and insured to offer this service to those wishing to pre-plan their funeral service. Pre-planning is beneficial to ensure your wishes are in place, reduces the stress for family and friends during a difficult and emotionally heightened time, and locks in today's prices on many items. Please contact your funeral professional for more information and make an appointment to take advantage of this service. We look forward to hearing from you and assisting you as needed.
Please click the link below to access a digital copy of our Pre-Planning & Bereavement Guide. Physical books are available at Robert Anderson Funeral Services, #115-190 MacAlpine Crescent, Fort McMurray, AB.
https://www.calameo.com/read/0066240283e65e73bb085
Compassionate Aftercare Service
We are now licensed and insured to help you with the essential paperwork that follows when your loved one passes. This service assists with alleviating the burden of completing all necessary documentation, such as Canada Pension Plan Death Benefit, Survivor's and Children's Benefit. We utilize a comprehensive online system that notifies the necessary entities of your loved one's passing. Therefore, all essential agencies will be contacted on your behalf. Our professionals are knowledgeable and will ensure this process runs smoothly and efficiently. Don't hesitate to contact your funeral professional for more information.
Follow us on Facebook
Meet the
COMPASSIONATE
STAFF
The dedicated and supportive staff of Robert Anderson Funeral Services, Inc. are here to guide you through this difficult journey. We take pride in doing our absolute best to ensure your needs are met. We are here for you.
AFFORDABLE
PRICING
Robert Anderson Funeral Services, Inc. will manage all the details from the first call of a death, through the service , on to the final disposition and aftercare.  Our staff will work with you to find the service that's right for you and your family.
Professional
Merchandise
After the funeral, we often desire to continue to honour our loved ones in ways that we hold dear. Robert Anderson Funeral Services, Inc. is pleased to offer a wide variety of funeral merchandise to help you in the days to come.
GRIEF
RESOURCES
The death of someone we care about can be indescribable. Words fail to describe how painful the grief we feel can be. We are proud to provide these guides in order to help begin the healing process.

Our staff is caring, committed and graced with the resources to arrange a day perfectly designed to commemorate the life and legacy of your loved one. Robert Anderson Funeral Services Inc. is wheelchair accessible and located just minutes from the Fort McMurray International Airport; an ideal location for visitors to the area.

Please feel free to browse our pages to learn more about pre-planning a funeral and grief support, as well as the traditional funeral and cremation services that we offer. If you have any questions or concerns, please  contact us anytime. Drop by the office as needed, or contact us via phone or e-mail. We are always here for you. 

Furthermore, we understand that it is not always possible to attend a service or a visitation in person. In light of this, we've created beautiful interactive online tributes to memorialize your loved one and now offer streaming services via Facebook Live or Zoom. You may also leave a condolence, share a memory, post a photo, light a candle, and more!


Robert Anderson Funeral Services Inc is pleased to now offer the following services

Pre-Arrangements and Payment Options

We are now licensed and insured to offer this service to those wishing to pre-plan their funeral service. Pre-planning is beneficial to ensure your wishes are in place, reduces the stress for family and friends during a difficult and emotionally heightened time, and locks in today's prices on many items. Please contact your funeral professional for more information and make an appointment to take advantage of this service. We look forward to hearing from you and assisting you as needed.

Please click the link below to access a digital copy of our Pre-Planning & Bereavement Guide. Physical books are available at Robert Anderson Funeral Services, #115-190 MacAlpine Crescent, Fort McMurray, AB. 

https://www.calameo.com/read/0066240283e65e73bb085

Compassionate Aftercare Service

We are now licensed and insured to help you with the essential paperwork that follows when your loved one passes. This service assists with alleviating the burden of completing all necessary documentation, such as Canada Pension Plan Death Benefit, Survivor's and Children's Benefit. We utilize a comprehensive online system that notifies the necessary entities of your loved one's passing. Therefore, all essential agencies will be contacted on your behalf. Our professionals are knowledgeable and will ensure this process runs smoothly and efficiently. Don't hesitate to contact your funeral professional for more information.

Follow us on Facebook 


Meet the 
COMPASSIONATE
STAFF

The dedicated and supportive staff of Robert Anderson Funeral Services, Inc. are here to guide you through this difficult journey. We take pride in doing our absolute best to ensure your needs are met. We are here for you.

AFFORDABLE
PRICING

Robert Anderson Funeral Services, Inc. will manage all the details from the first call of a death, through the service , on to the final disposition and aftercare.  Our staff will work with you to find the service that's right for you and your family. 

Professional
Merchandise

After the funeral, we often desire to continue to honour our loved ones in ways that we hold dear. Robert Anderson Funeral Services, Inc. is pleased to offer a wide variety of funeral merchandise to help you in the days to come.

GRIEF
RESOURCES

The death of someone we care about can be indescribable. Words fail to describe how painful the grief we feel can be. We are proud to provide these guides in order to help begin the healing process.​

About Us
Service From The Heart
For decades, Robert Anderson Funeral Services Inc. has provided families throughout the Regional Municipality of Wood Buffalo with completely personalized funeral services to memorialize their loved ones. Our reputation for dependable, and prompt service has earned us the trust of families throughout the community. Our licensed funeral directors and embalmers have the experience to provide a complete service and to make a difficult day become a pleasant and even healing one.
We’re proud to offer the community a range of funeral and memorial services to help commemorate a life. Our devoted staff will help you make the arrangements for traditional earth burials or cremation services. We carry a wide line of caskets, grave markers, monuments and urns designed to match any style and budget. We can also connect you with a company that specializes in transforming cremated remains into timeless jewellery pieces. Our network includes reputable florists who will incorporate the timeless beauty of nature to a funeral service. Whether your loved one will be buried in a casket or cremated, we can provide provincial and international shipping options to your chosen destination. Call us today to discuss your specific needs.
Our staff is fully committed to ensuring your complete comfort and satisfaction. We have the resources to provide a wide range of services and assistance to help you navigate the funeral and memorial process. At Robert Anderson Funeral Services Inc., you can expect
service from the heart
.

Celebrating Moments.
Honoring Memories.
The loss of a loved one can leave you with a lot of unanswered questions, feelings of stress and anxiety and grief that makes events difficult to handle. The experienced funeral directors at Reflections Funeral & Cremation Services will guide you through the aspects of the funeral service with compassion, dignity and respect.
Our honest service and commitment to excellence have served our customers well, and you can rest assured that we can assist you in your time of need. Whether you have come to our site for information about an upcoming service or to make arrangements for one, we hope the information you find here will be helpful. Serving Vermilion and area. Locally owned and operated.
We are available to you on a 24/7 basis through phone
(780.581.1550
) or email (office@reflectionsfuneral.com). Our office hours are Monday through Friday from 10 a.m. until 4 p.m. (closed for lunch between 12-1) but we’re able to take appointments to meet in office whenever works best for you. Please don’t hesitate to contact us with your needs.

Reflections and Creech’s Lakeland
Transition Completed
As of March 2, 2026, Reflections purchase of Creech’s Lakeland (Vermilion) was completed.
We are now the sole licensed funeral home operating in Vermilion.
All funeral services will be coordinated through our current facility located at 4902B – 50 Avenue,   Vermilion.
This arrangement will remain in place until renovations at the Lakeland facility are        completed. A confirmed move date will be communicated once finalized.
We would also like to confirm that all pre-arranged funeral services previously made with Creech’s Lakeland Funeral Home (Vermilion) have been formally transferred to Reflections Funeral & Cremation Services and will be fully honored in accordance with the original arrangements.
Reflections also received all historical service records, files, obituary archives, and electronic records associated with Creech’s Lakeland Funeral Home (Vermilion) and related service areas.
From the Families We Serve:
We are always interested in hearing from the families that we serve.  Please take a moment to let us know how well we served you in your time of need. We very much appreciate your feedback.

Celebrating Moments.
Honoring Memories.
The loss of a loved one can leave you with a lot of unanswered questions, feelings of stress and anxiety and grief that makes events difficult to handle. The experienced funeral directors at Reflections Funeral & Cremation Services will guide you through the aspects of the funeral service with compassion, dignity and respect.
Our honest service and commitment to excellence have served our customers well, and you can rest assured that we can assist you in your time of need. Whether you have come to our site for information about an upcoming service or to make arrangements for one, we hope the information you find here will be helpful. Serving Vermilion and area. Locally owned and operated.
We are available to you on a 24/7 basis through phone
(780.581.1550
) or email (office@reflectionsfuneral.com). Our office hours are Monday through Friday from 10 a.m. until 4 p.m. (closed for lunch between 12-1) but we’re able to take appointments to meet in office whenever works best for you. Please don’t hesitate to contact us with your needs.

Reflections and Creech’s Lakeland
Transition Completed
As of March 2, 2026, Reflections purchase of Creech’s Lakeland (Vermilion) was completed.
We are now the sole licensed funeral home operating in Vermilion.
All funeral services will be coordinated through our current facility located at 4902B – 50 Avenue,   Vermilion.
This arrangement will remain in place until renovations at the Lakeland facility are        completed. A confirmed move date will be communicated once finalized.
We would also like to confirm that all pre-arranged funeral services previously made with Creech’s Lakeland Funeral Home (Vermilion) have been formally transferred to Reflections Funeral & Cremation Services and will be fully honored in accordance with the original arrangements.
Reflections also received all historical service records, files, obituary archives, and electronic records associated with Creech’s Lakeland Funeral Home (Vermilion) and related service areas.

<script type="text/javascript">
var pushData = (data) => {
  dataLayer.push(data);
}

var replaceUndefined = (value) => {
  return value ? value : 'Null';
}

pushDeceasedInfo = (days, age, type) => {
  pushData({
    "dInfo": {
      "dDays": replaceUndefined(days),
      "dAge": replaceUndefined(age),

        let uuid = "crypto" in window && window.crypto.randomUUID && window.crypto.randomUUID();
        if (!uuid) {
            uuid = String(now.getTime().toString(32) + Math.random().toString(16)).replace(/\./g, '-');

        now.setTime(now.getTime() + 3600 * 1000);// 1 hour

OUR FAMILY SERVING YOURS
It is with great pride to say that Salmon & Sons Funeral Home is 100% independently owned and operated.
We honour all prearrangements from other funeral homes, and are able to transfer prearrangements at no cost.
We provide a wide range of funeral services for Lethbridge and Southern Alberta.
Every family has unique needs and we do everything to ensure that these needs are met. Services we provide include:
Traditional Funeral services
Transfer of Prearrangements from other Funeral Homes
Memorial services
Grave side services
Immediate cremation services
Prearrangement planning services
Aftercare
We are available 24 hours, 7 days a week and are always here for you no matter what time of day or night.
There is no definitive timeline when a loved one passes away and at that moment Salmon & Sons is here for you and your family.
We want to be available whenever you need us and we are able to come to your home for arrangements if this is your preference.
Our comfort dog Aspen, is also available for those who wish.  She gives unconditional love to all of those who need it and adds a personal touch to your service from the Salmon & Sons family.
Our chapel is available for on-site services, with arrangement office, casket and urn showroom, family room, as well as ample parking and we are proud to serve ALL religions and faiths
We believe everyone should have access to compassionate and honest services when dealing with the death of a loved one and you can easily find us located near the entrance to the Lethbridge Airport.
We are what you look for in a Funeral Home: Compassionate. We take pride in the feeling of helping loved ones going through one of their toughest times in life and we would be very honoured to be there for you and your family.
Salmon & Sons strives to provide the best Funeral Home in Lethbridge built upon strong values such as honesty, integrity and compassion.
We want to extend a huge thank you to all of our family and friends who helped make the last 7 years amazing.  We couldn’t have done it without you.
Sincerely,
Nicolas and Max Salmon

OUR FAMILY SERVING YOURS
It is with great pride to say that Salmon & Sons Funeral Home is 100% independently owned and operated.
We honour all prearrangements from other funeral homes, and are able to transfer prearrangements at no cost.
We provide a wide range of funeral services for Lethbridge and Southern Alberta.
Every family has unique needs and we do everything to ensure that these needs are met. Services we provide include:
Traditional Funeral services
Transfer of Prearrangements from other Funeral Homes
Memorial services
Grave side services
Immediate cremation services
Prearrangement planning services
Aftercare
We are available 24 hours, 7 days a week and are always here for you no matter what time of day or night.
There is no definitive timeline when a loved one passes away and at that moment Salmon & Sons is here for you and your family.
We want to be available whenever you need us and we are able to come to your home for arrangements if this is your preference.
Our comfort dog Aspen, is also available for those who wish.  She gives unconditional love to all of those who need it and adds a personal touch to your service from the Salmon & Sons family.
Our chapel is available for on-site services, with arrangement office, casket and urn showroom, family room, as well as ample parking and we are proud to serve ALL religions and faiths
We believe everyone should have access to compassionate and honest services when dealing with the death of a loved one and you can easily find us located near the entrance to the Lethbridge Airport.
We are what you look for in a Funeral Home: Compassionate. We take pride in the feeling of helping loved ones going through one of their toughest times in life and we would be very honoured to be there for you and your family.
Salmon & Sons strives to provide the best Funeral Home in Lethbridge built upon strong values such as honesty, integrity and compassion.
We want to extend a huge thank you to all of our family and friends who helped make the last 7 years amazing.  We couldn’t have done it without you.
Sincerely,
Nicolas and Max Salmon

    API.fBxWallUser = null;

    function processNewUserLogin(user, saveUserUrl) {
        function login() {
            if (user != null) {
                API.fBxWallUser = JSON.stringify(user);
            }

            document.getElementById('loginForm').click();
        }

        if (user && saveUserUrl) {
            fetch(saveUserUrl, {
                method: 'POST',
                body: JSON.stringify(user),
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                }
            }).then(function (res) {
                return res.json();
            }).then(function (response) {
                if (response) {
                    user = res;
                    login();
                }
            }).catch(function (error) {
                return console.error('Error:', error);
            });
        } else { login(); }
    }

Southland Funeral Chapel (
formerly Reardon’s Funeral Service
) is an independent, locally owned, full service funeral home and has been serving Taber and surrounding communities for more than fifty years. Having trained in communities large and small throughout Alberta, our experienced Funeral Directors have acquired a unique understanding of the diverse needs and customs of individuals and faith groups.
Our commitment to compassionate personal service and attention to detail is evident by the continued trust families place in Southland Funeral Chapel to care for them and for their loved ones.
You may not realize how many options you have, or the number of decisions you will need to make during such a difficult time. Whether you have an immediate need for service, or you are planning ahead, we sincerely hope you will find this site useful in helping you to make informed decisions.

PROUD MEMBERS OF
You and your family are at the heart of everything we do.
Welcome to the comforting embrace of Cochrane Country Funeral Home, serving communities like Cochrane, Canmore, Calgary, Cremona, Sundre, Bragg Creek, and Springbank with exceptional and compassionate care since 1998.
As a continuation of the caring legacies of Lawrence (Larry) Slywka (1998 – 2009) and Ron Fitzpatrick (2009 – 2015), we are now a proud Division of Pierson’s Funeral Service. This association only strengthens our ability to deliver the compassionate care you’ve come to trust and expect from us.
Every member of our team is devoted to offering personalized services and honouring your unique needs with the utmost kindness, integrity, and value. We are deeply conscious that our reputation rests not just on what is seen but also on what is deeply felt in the hearts of the families we serve.
﻿
Your trust and recommendations are the bedrock of our service; they are a testament to our commitment and a validation of our service philosophy. Your confidence in us is born from our consistent efforts to provide superior service at fair and moderate prices.
HOW WE CAN HELP
Our Services
and Offerings
If you've experienced a loss, or are planning in advance, we are here for your each step of the way. Planning a funeral is an emotional and sometimes overwhelming thing and having the right information can make things easier.
It is our mission to serve families in their time of need and welcome any questions you have.
OUR SERVICES
OUR SERVICES
Every life is unique, and every service should be as well. We invite you to learn more about our services.
LEARN MORE
GRIEF SUPPORT
GRIEF SUPPORT
Our grief support page provides a compassionate and safe space for those grieving the loss of a loved one. Find comfort and healing through shared experiences and resources.
LEARN MORE

Plan for the future with our expert guidance on financial planning and end-of-life decisions. Ensure your wishes are carried out and gain peace of mind today.
LEARN MORE

PROUD MEMBERS OF
You and your family are at the heart of everything we do.
Welcome to the comforting embrace of Cochrane Country Funeral Home, serving communities like Cochrane, Canmore, Calgary, Cremona, Sundre, Bragg Creek, and Springbank with exceptional and compassionate care since 1998.
As a continuation of the caring legacies of Lawrence (Larry) Slywka (1998 – 2009) and Ron Fitzpatrick (2009 – 2015), we are now a proud Division of Pierson’s Funeral Service. This association only strengthens our ability to deliver the compassionate care you’ve come to trust and expect from us.
Every member of our team is devoted to offering personalized services and honouring your unique needs with the utmost kindness, integrity, and value. We are deeply conscious that our reputation rests not just on what is seen but also on what is deeply felt in the hearts of the families we serve.

WHY CHOOSE US
The passing of a loved one is a difficult time for a family.
Country Hills Crematorium is here to support you through the process of preparing to say goodbye with compassionate
funeral planning service that is tailored to your unique needs from a locally owned and operated family business.
Throughout the process, you may need assistance and advice which we are here to provide for you.
We facilitate all of the services you need after a death has occurred from arranging final disposition
to funeral ceremonies and receptions to  support after the service.
Our Calgary funeral home and crematorium provides services that bring comfort to you
and honour the life of the loved one you have lost.
Learn something about
OUR FACILITIES
We are one of Calgary’s newest cremation and funeral services facilities. This means we have a state of the art facility that has been designed with your comfort and well being in mind.
Our bright, open spaces offer various options for funeral services, memorials and other celebrations and rituals. Our facilities were expertly designed to give you the most comfortable and convenient location to say goodbye to your loved one.
Our team is here to provide compassionate
funeral planning Calgary
families can rely on during this difficult time.
MORE ABOUT US
In loving memory
OBITUARIES
VIEW ALL OBITUARIES
Hear people’s experiences
TESTIMONIALS
Professional and compassionate services by Country Hills Crematorium. Clean and well kept facility. Special thank you to Mark and Jody for their professionalism, as expressed by our entire family.
JM
The facility is clean and the staff are very understanding. We had the pleasure of working with Jyoti and Mark during a time when we felt our world collapsed. They were supportive and treated our loved ones with respect.
Ashley R.
This is a great place for peace of life services. The staff here is amazingly patient and helpful. They guided us through the entire process and were very accommodating with everything. Services are very well priced too. I recommend them very strongly to everyone dealing with the loss of a loved one. It still is very painful to say goodbye but with these people, you are in good hands.
Rahul R.
I would highly recommend Country Hills Crematorium to anyone at their difficult time. My experience with Calgary Crematorium was nothing less than fantastic. The process was simple and they were accommodating all of our requests. Special thanks to Jody for her calm and composed demeanor and taking care of my aunt during this sad and difficult time for my family. Thank you!
Reet K.
Excellent service.. I attended funeral last week here for my Paaji Iqbal Brar. It was sad moment for us but Staff was very helpful. Arrangements was very good.
Arvind B.
A few weeks ago we lost a close family friend/brother figure. Upon arriving at the funeral home for the private viewing, my husband, sister in law and her husband were greeted by the new manager of the facility (who coincidentally also helped us with my father in laws funeral 2 1/2yrs ago).
Very compassionate service and assistance. Beautiful and well maintained facility. Thank you, Chad.
Elisa B.
Thank you so much for your outstanding service provided by dedicated staff. My husband passed away so unexpectedly. The customer care and service we received during our difficult time help us to get thorough everything. Special thanks to Jody. She was very professional and helpful.
Sarita G.
We recommend and thank you Jody and her team for working with us. They were very heartful and helpful, always thinking of our family during the difficult times. Jody worked with us in a professional manner and always understanding. Thank you.
Sam L.
We are thankful and appreciative for the support and funeral planning services we received from Mark and staff during such difficult times. Each option/service was explained and we were able to choose what was best. They were accommodating and the facility is modern and spacious and very welcoming.
Victoria B.
Mark and his team were so wonderful! They were there for us in our darkest days. Mark was such a kind, gentle and caring man for my Sisters and I. Thank you very much for everything.
Alisha C.

WHY CHOOSE US
The passing of a loved one is a difficult time for a family.
Country Hills Crematorium is here to support you through the process of preparing to say goodbye with compassionate
funeral planning service that is tailored to your unique needs from a locally owned and operated family business.
Throughout the process, you may need assistance and advice which we are here to provide for you.
We facilitate all of the services you need after a death has occurred from arranging final disposition
to funeral ceremonies and receptions to  support after the service.
Our Calgary funeral home and crematorium provides services that bring comfort to you
and honour the life of the loved one you have lost.
Learn something about
OUR FACILITIES
We are one of Calgary’s newest cremation and funeral services facilities. This means we have a state of the art facility that has been designed with your comfort and well being in mind.
Our bright, open spaces offer various options for funeral services, memorials and other celebrations and rituals. Our facilities were expertly designed to give you the most comfortable and convenient location to say goodbye to your loved one.
Our team is here to provide compassionate
funeral planning Calgary
families can rely on during this difficult time.
MORE ABOUT US
In loving memory
OBITUARIES
VIEW ALL OBITUARIES
Hear people’s experiences
TESTIMONIALS
Professional and compassionate services by Country Hills Crematorium. Clean and well kept facility. Special thank you to Mark and Jody for their professionalism, as expressed by our entire family.
JM
The facility is clean and the staff are very understanding. We had the pleasure of working with Jyoti and Mark during a time when we felt our world collapsed. They were supportive and treated our loved ones with respect.
Ashley R.
This is a great place for peace of life services. The staff here is amazingly patient and helpful. They guided us through the entire process and were very accommodating with everything. Services are very well priced too. I recommend them very strongly to everyone dealing with the loss of a loved one. It still is very painful to say goodbye but with these people, you are in good hands.
Rahul R.
I would highly recommend Country Hills Crematorium to anyone at their difficult time. My experience with Calgary Crematorium was nothing less than fantastic. The process was simple and they were accommodating all of our requests. Special thanks to Jody for her calm and composed demeanor and taking care of my aunt during this sad and difficult time for my family. Thank you!
Reet K.
Excellent service.. I attended funeral last week here for my Paaji Iqbal Brar. It was sad moment for us but Staff was very helpful. Arrangements was very good.
Arvind B.
A few weeks ago we lost a close family friend/brother figure. Upon arriving at the funeral home for the private viewing, my husband, sister in law and her husband were greeted by the new manager of the facility (who coincidentally also helped us with my father in laws funeral 2 1/2yrs ago).
Very compassionate service and assistance. Beautiful and well maintained facility. Thank you, Chad.
Elisa B.
Thank you so much for your outstanding service provided by dedicated staff. My husband passed away so unexpectedly. The customer care and service we received during our difficult time help us to get thorough everything. Special thanks to Jody. She was very professional and helpful.
Sarita G.
We recommend and thank you Jody and her team for working with us. They were very heartful and helpful, always thinking of our family during the difficult times. Jody worked with us in a professional manner and always understanding. Thank you.
Sam L.
We are thankful and appreciative for the support and funeral planning services we received from Mark and staff during such difficult times. Each option/service was explained and we were able to choose what was best. They were accommodating and the facility is modern and spacious and very welcoming.
Victoria B.
Mark and his team were so wonderful! They were there for us in our darkest days. Mark was such a kind, gentle and caring man for my Sisters and I. Thank you very much for everything.
Alisha C.
We are always
HERE TO HELP
When a death occurs in your family, you will be faced with the task of making decisions during a very difficult time. Remember that you are not alone. We are available any time of day to assist you in ensuring the wishes of your family are carried out.
CALL NOW

About
Established in 1984 as Riverview Funeral Services, First Memorial Funeral Services
®
- Riverview Chapel is Fort Saskatchewan, Alberta’s only full-service funeral home. Located conveniently at the entrance to the City of Fort Saskatchewan Cemetery, we have been a preferred funeral home for area residents since 1997.
Our welcoming funeral home
Our facility features a very distinctive style both inside and out and is an architectural asset to the area. It is our commitment to provide you with a comfortable home-like atmosphere with modern and innovative appliances and decor. As part of the services we offer at First Memorial Funeral Services
®
- Riverview Chapel, we provide access to CD and DVD audio-visual equipment.
Our visitation room provides a welcoming, private suite and can also be used by families to privately observe a service. The chapel can be opened up to the visitation room to allow for overflow seating for larger services, and our reception room off the chapel is available for after-service gatherings. Our facilities also include a kitchen for preparation of catered meals and refreshments. We offer catering services with a hostess for an additional fee.
Personalized services
We love to listen to your story and craft a service that truly honours and celebrates the life of your loved one. With a wide
range of options
available to you, ranging from
traditional funeral
services, to
cremations
with celebratory memorials, we are confident it will be a tribute remembered for years to come.
Community commitment
As part of our commitment to the Fort Saskatchewan community, we are involved in various local organizations and events, including the Chamber of Commerce and
Prevent Alcohol and Risk Related Trauma in Youth (P.A.R.T.Y.) Program
. We have been locally recognized for our community contributions.
A trusted provider

Remembrance
“Every detail remembered” is more than a tagline. It’s how we do everything, including offering meaningful ways to honor and remember a loved one.
Learn More
Online memorial
More than an obituary, our free online memorial allows you to share service details and invite family and friends to contribute photos, videos and fond memories.
Keepsake program
Many who attend a celebration of life keep the program. A tangible representation of a loving memory, it may include an obituary, photos, poems and more.
Tribute movie
A video of cherished photos helps tell a special story. We play it during the celebration and then give it to you to play again and again, as often as you’d like.
Memory book
A collection of images and heartfelt messages from family and friends captures the essence of a loved one’s life in a book future generations will cherish.

                <div class="about-description">
<p>
Established in 1984 as Riverview Funeral Services, First Memorial Funeral Services<sup>®</sup> - Riverview Chapel is Fort Saskatchewan, Alberta’s only full-service funeral home. Located conveniently at the entrance to the City of Fort Saskatchewan Cemetery, we have been a preferred funeral home for area residents since 1997.
</p>                </div>
<h2>
Our welcoming funeral home
</h2>
<p>
<img data-src="/dfsmedia/042808e1630c49a48950d5077d6556eb/57735-50067/3648-exterior-006" alt="First Memorial Funeral Services - Riverview Chapel" style="width: 280px; height: 140px; float: left;" />Our facility features a very distinctive style both inside and out and is an architectural asset to the area. It is our commitment to provide you with a comfortable home-like atmosphere with modern and innovative appliances and decor. As part of the services we offer at First Memorial Funeral Services<sup>®</sup> - Riverview Chapel, we provide access to CD and DVD audio-visual equipment.
</p>
<p>
Our visitation room provides a welcoming, private suite and can also be used by families to privately observe a service. The chapel can be opened up to the visitation room to allow for overflow seating for larger services, and our reception room off the chapel is available for after-service gatherings. Our facilities also include a kitchen for preparation of catered meals and refreshments. We offer catering services with a hostess for an additional fee.
</p>
<h2>Personalized services</h2>
<p><img data-src="/dfsmedia/042808e1630c49a48950d5077d6556eb/57743-50067/3648-chapel003" style="width: 280px; height: 140px; float: right;" />We love to listen to your story and craft a service that truly honours and celebrates the life of your loved one. With a wide <a href="/plan-funeral-cremation">range of options</a> available to you, ranging from <a href="/memorial-services/planning-a-funeral/traditional-funeral">traditional funeral</a> services, to <a href="/cremation/planning-a-cremation">cremations</a> with celebratory memorials, we are confident it will be a tribute remembered for years to come.</p>
<h2>
Community commitment
</h2>
<p>
As part of our commitment to the Fort Saskatchewan community, we are involved in various local organizations and events, including the Chamber of Commerce and <a rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank" href="http://partyprogram.com">Prevent Alcohol and Risk Related Trauma in Youth (P.A.R.T.Y.) Program</a>. We have been locally recognized for our community contributions.
</p>
<h2> A trusted provider</h2>
<p>First Memorial Funeral Services<sup>®</sup> - Riverview Chapel is a part of the Dignity Memorial<sup>®</sup> network. When you choose us as your provider, you receive the compassionate care you expect from a locally operated establishment and the benefits and value you deserve from North America’s largest network of funeral, cremation and cemetery service providers. </p>
<h2>
Contact us
</h2>
<p>
Please contact us if you are in need of <a href="/immediate-need">immediate assistance</a> or would like additional information about our products and services. We look forward to serving you.
</p>                                    <div>

<script>
    var currentLanguage = 'en';

    $(function () {
        Handlebars.registerHelper('formatRating', function (ratingsNumber) {
            return generateRatings(ratingsNumber);
        });
        Handlebars.registerHelper("getPercentage", function (startCount, totalCount) {

            var percentage = 100 * startCount / totalCount;
            return percentage.toFixed();

        });

        Handlebars.registerHelper('filterByRating', function (reviews, minRating, options) {
            const filtered = reviews.filter(review => review.FuneralOverallRating >= minRating);
            return options.fn({ Reviews: filtered });
        });

        Handlebars.registerHelper('formatFullDate', function (dateString) {
            return new Handlebars.SafeString(
                moment(dateString).locale(currentLanguage).format("MMMM YYYY")
            );
        });

        Handlebars.registerHelper('iff', function (a, operator, b, opts) {
            var bool = false;
            switch (operator) {
                case '==':
                    bool = a == b;
                    break;
                case '>':
                    bool = a > b;
                    break;
                case '<':
                    bool = a < b;
                    break;
                default:
                    throw "Unknown operator " + operator;
            }

            if (bool) {
                return opts.fn(this);
            } else {
                return opts.inverse(this);
            }
        });
    });
</script>
