<script type="text/x-handlebars-template" id="pricing-carousel-template">
    {{#if Cards}}
    <div class="component carousel carousel-multiple-items carousel-show-dots carousel-pricing">
        {{#each Cards}}
        {{#if Code}}
        {{#if ShowPrice}}
        {{#if Price}}
        <div class="component surfaced-item surfaced-item-vertical regular-card">
            <div class="pricing-card-container">
                <div class="pricing-card-photo lazy" data-bg="{{Image.Url}}">
                    {{#if ImageDisclaimerText}}
                    <div class="disclaimer-overlay">
                        <p class="disclaimer-overlay-text">{{ImageDisclaimerText}}</p>
                    </div>
                    {{/if}}

                    {{#ifOr ShowMediaCarousel ShowTourCarousel}}
                    {{#ifOr MediaCarouselImages Tour360CarouselImages}}
                    {{#with CtaAction}}
                    {{#ifEquals Anchor "#overlay-photo"}}
                    <a class="view-pricing-gallery view-details gtm-{{../SanitizedCode}}-view-pricing-gallery" data-toggle="modal" data-loc-id="{{LocationId}}" data-card-type="{{../SanitizedCode}}" data-target="#overlay-{{#parseId ../SanitizedCode}}{{/parseId}}" tabindex="0"><span>{{Text}}</span></a>
                    {{/ifEquals}}
                    {{/with}}
                    {{/ifOr}}
                    {{/ifOr}}
                </div>

                <div class="pricing-data-container">
                    <h3>{{Title}}</h3>

                    {{#if Subtitle}}
                    <div class="pricing-guests">
                        {{#with ../SecondaryIcon}}
                        <img src="data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAAAACH5BAEKAAEALAAAAAABAAEAAAICTAEAOw==" data-src="{{Url}}" alt="{{Description}}" class="pricing-subtitle-icon" />
                        {{/with}}
                        <span>{{Subtitle}}</span>

                    </div>
                    {{/if}}

                    <p>{{Description}}</p>
                </div>

                <div class="pricing-data-footer">
                    {{#if ShowCustomQuote}}
                        <a class="{{CustomQuoteCssClass}} custom-quote" data-toggle="modal" data-target="{{CustomQuoteDataTarget}}">{{CustomQuoteText}}</a>
                    {{else}}
                        <div class="pricing-value-start">
                            <span class="starting-at">{{PricingLabel}}</span>
                            <span class="price">{{#parsePrice Price}}{{/parsePrice}}</span>
                        </div>
                    {{/if}}

                    {{#with CtaAction}}
                    {{#ifEquals Anchor "#overlay"}}
                    <div class="pricing-cta">
                        <a class="{{CssClass}} view-details gtm-{{../SanitizedCode}}-view-details" data-loc-id="{{LocationId}}" data-card-type="{{../SanitizedCode}}" data-toggle="modal" data-target="#overlay-{{#parseId ../SanitizedCode}}{{/parseId}}" tabindex="0"><span>{{Text}}</span></a>
                    </div>
                    {{else}}
                    {{#ifNotEquals Anchor "#overlay-photo"}}
                    <div class="pricing-cta">
                        <a class="{{CssClass}} gtm-{{../SanitizedCode}}-view-link" {{#if Target}} target="{{Target}}" {{/if}} href="{{Url}}"><span>{{Text}}</span></a>
                    </div>
                    {{/ifNotEquals}}
                    {{/ifEquals}}
                    {{/with}}
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{/if}}
        {{/if}}
        {{/each}}
    </div>
    {{/if}}
</script>
<script>
    var locale = 'en';

    $(function () {
        Handlebars.registerHelper('ifEquals', function (arg1, arg2, options) {
            return (arg1 === arg2) ? options.fn(this) : options.inverse(this);
        });

        Handlebars.registerHelper('ifNotEquals', function (arg1, arg2, options) {
            return (arg1 != arg2) ? options.fn(this) : options.inverse(this);
        });

        Handlebars.registerHelper('parsePrice', function (arg1) {
            return parseInt(arg1).toLocaleString(locale);
        });

        Handlebars.registerHelper('lcase', function (arg1) {
            return arg1.toLowerCase();
        });

        Handlebars.registerHelper('parseId', function (arg1) {
            return arg1.replace(/^[^a-zA-Z]+|[^\w:.-]+/g, "");
        });

        Handlebars.registerHelper('ifOr', function (arg1, arg2, options) {
            arg1 = Array.isArray(arg1) ? arg1.length : arg1;
            arg2 = Array.isArray(arg2) ? arg2.length : arg2;

            return (arg1 || arg2) ? options.fn(this) : options.inverse(this);
        });

        Handlebars.registerHelper('ifAnd', function (arg1, arg2, options) {
            arg1 = Array.isArray(arg1) ? arg1.length : arg1;
            arg2 = Array.isArray(arg2) ? arg2.length : arg2;

            return (arg1 && arg2) ? options.fn(this) : options.inverse(this);
        });
    });
</script>

About
Established in 1984 as Riverview Funeral Services, First Memorial Funeral Services
®
- Riverview Chapel is Fort Saskatchewan, Alberta’s only full-service funeral home. Located conveniently at the entrance to the City of Fort Saskatchewan Cemetery, we have been a preferred funeral home for area residents since 1997.
Our welcoming funeral home
Our facility features a very distinctive style both inside and out and is an architectural asset to the area. It is our commitment to provide you with a comfortable home-like atmosphere with modern and innovative appliances and decor. As part of the services we offer at First Memorial Funeral Services
®
- Riverview Chapel, we provide access to CD and DVD audio-visual equipment.
Our visitation room provides a welcoming, private suite and can also be used by families to privately observe a service. The chapel can be opened up to the visitation room to allow for overflow seating for larger services, and our reception room off the chapel is available for after-service gatherings. Our facilities also include a kitchen for preparation of catered meals and refreshments. We offer catering services with a hostess for an additional fee.
Personalized services
We love to listen to your story and craft a service that truly honours and celebrates the life of your loved one. With a wide
range of options
available to you, ranging from
traditional funeral
services, to
cremations
with celebratory memorials, we are confident it will be a tribute remembered for years to come.
Community commitment
As part of our commitment to the Fort Saskatchewan community, we are involved in various local organizations and events, including the Chamber of Commerce and
Prevent Alcohol and Risk Related Trauma in Youth (P.A.R.T.Y.) Program
. We have been locally recognized for our community contributions.
A trusted provider
First Memorial Funeral Services
®
- Riverview Chapel is a part of the Dignity Memorial
®
network. When you choose us as your provider, you receive the compassionate care you expect from a locally operated establishment and the benefits and value you deserve from North America’s largest network of funeral, cremation and cemetery service providers.
Contact us
Please contact us if you are in need of
immediate assistance
or would like additional information about our products and services. We look forward to serving you.

Remembrance

Learn More
Online memorial
More than an obituary, our free online memorial allows you to share service details and invite family and friends to contribute photos, videos and fond memories.
Keepsake program
Many who attend a celebration of life keep the program. A tangible representation of a loving memory, it may include an obituary, photos, poems and more.
Tribute movie
A video of cherished photos helps tell a special story. We play it during the celebration and then give it to you to play again and again, as often as you’d like.

About
Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium provides funeral, cremation and memorial services in Calgary and surrounding areas.
Chapel at Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium
Located on 4th Street Northwest, the funeral home is just a 20-minute drive from Calgary International Airport, with a public transit stop near our front entrance. The chapel's exit leading to our climate-controlled concourse provides comfortable funeral vehicle access throughout the year. The entire building is wheelchair accessible.
The chapel and fireside lounge
Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium has a distinctly warm and comforting environment. Our 23,500-square-foot Tudor-style building includes one of the larger funeral chapels in Calgary. It seats 250 people and has lovely 16-foot stained-glass windows that span floor to ceiling. The chapel features oak pews and a cathedral-style ceiling, creating excellent acoustics. Families have a choice of organ or digital grand piano for musical accompaniment.
Whether gathering for visitations, as a family before a service or for a reception, our fireside lounge is a warm, comfortable place to meet. Central to the room is a floor-to-ceiling fieldstone fireplace.
On-site crematory and convenient cemetery
Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium is located directly across from Queen’s Park Cemetery. We’re experienced at coordinating burial needs with this cemetery and others throughout Calgary and the surrounding area. For  families choosing
cremation
, we have an on-site crematorium.
The Foster's team celebrates life
We pride ourselves on having compassionate and sincere associates who embody a deep commitment to caring. They are experienced in serving people of many faiths, cultures and backgrounds.
We've adapted to the diverse needs and wants of the community when it comes to funerals and celebration of life services. Though many families choose
traditional funeral services
, the team also offers contemporary options and
personalized services
.
If desired, our Dignity Memorial® celebrant will visit with your family, discover the story of your loved one and create a ceremony that beautifully incorporates their hobbies, passions and spirit. The creative possibilities are endless.
Asian services and burning room
Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium is specially equipped for services for Asian and Buddhist families. A room with a fireplace is conveniently located adjacent to our chapel to accommodate traditional burning ceremonies with the maximum safety and comfort.
Our team has extensive experience in planning ceremonies according to Chinese traditions as well. Even for Canadians who are 2nd- and 3rd-generation Chinese, we can offer guidance in traditional customs. If your family members speak only Chinese, let us know and we can bring in someone who speaks fluent Chinese.
Community involvement and events
At Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium, we are committed to helping others and  take great pride in giving back to our community. Every year we host our Easter Egg Hunt, Children’s Costume Party and Stampede Barbeque. We support local charities through our annual Charity Garage Sale as well as other events.
We also take great pride in offering our annual Christmas Candlelight Memorial Service to  families we have served throughout the year and anyone in the community who wishes to attend.
Here for you
Whether you need
immediate assistance
or would like to know more about our services, please contact us. At Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium, we are here for you.
History
The founder of what is now Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium was Cy Foster. He opened his original funeral home on 16th Avenue Northwest in Calgary, under the name Foster’s Garden Chapel on a freezing December 3, 1956. He had 7 calls that first month, 15 the next and 300 by the end of the first year.
The funeral home business grows
Over the years, Cy partnered with the Gooder Brothers to open 2 other funeral homes: Cy Foster-Gooder’s Chapel on the Hill (located at 1708 16th Ave. NW) and Cy Foster-Gooder Hillside Chapel (located at 1635 17th Ave. SW).
In the 1980s, Foster's decided to open a new funeral home that would be an amalgamation of the 3 original funeral homes. Construction at our present location, across from Queen’s Park Cemetery, began in 1988. The new Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium opened on July 27, 1989.
Upholding a tradition
Though it’s been decades since Cy opened his first funeral home, the team at Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium upholds his commitment to helping families through the emotional challenges of planning funerals, cremations and burials.

Remembrance
“Every detail remembered” is more than a tagline. It’s how we do everything, including offering meaningful ways to honor and remember a loved one.
Learn More
Online memorial
More than an obituary, our free online memorial allows you to share service details and invite family and friends to contribute photos, videos and fond memories.
Keepsake program
Many who attend a celebration of life keep the program. A tangible representation of a loving memory, it may include an obituary, photos, poems and more.
Tribute movie
A video of cherished photos helps tell a special story. We play it during the celebration and then give it to you to play again and again, as often as you’d like.
Memory book
A collection of images and heartfelt messages from family and friends captures the essence of a loved one’s life in a book future generations will cherish.

        <h2>About</h2>
            <div class="hide-extra-paragraphs hide-extra-sections">
                <div class="about-description">
<p>
Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium provides funeral, cremation and memorial services in Calgary and surrounding areas.
</p>                </div>
<h2>
Chapel at Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium</h2>
<p>
<img src="data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAAAACH5BAEKAAEALAAAAAABAAEAAAICTAEAOw==" alt="Chapel at Foster's Garden Chapel & Crematorium" style="width: 280px; height: 140px; float: left;" data-src="/dfsmedia/042808e1630c49a48950d5077d6556eb/3125-50073/3600-chapel-1-jpg">Located on 4th Street Northwest, the funeral home is just a 20-minute drive from Calgary International Airport, with a public transit stop near our front entrance. The chapel's exit leading to our climate-controlled concourse provides comfortable funeral vehicle access throughout the year. The entire building is wheelchair accessible.</p>
<h2>
The chapel and fireside lounge
</h2>
<p>Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium has a distinctly warm and comforting environment. Our 23,500-square-foot Tudor-style building includes one of the larger funeral chapels in Calgary. It seats 250 people and has lovely 16-foot stained-glass windows that span floor to ceiling. The chapel features oak pews and a cathedral-style ceiling, creating excellent acoustics. Families have a choice of organ or digital grand piano for musical accompaniment. </p>
<p><img src="data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAAAACH5BAEKAAEALAAAAAABAAEAAAICTAEAOw==" alt="Fireside lounge at Foster's Garden Chapel and Crematorium." style="width: 280px; height: 140px; float: right;" data-src="/dfsmedia/042808e1630c49a48950d5077d6556eb/3130-50073/3600-lobby-1-jpg">Whether gathering for visitations, as a family before a service or for a reception, our fireside lounge is a warm, comfortable place to meet. Central to the room is a floor-to-ceiling fieldstone fireplace. </p>
<h2>
On-site crematory and convenient cemetery
</h2>
<p>Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium is located directly across from Queen’s Park Cemetery. We’re experienced at coordinating burial needs with this cemetery and others throughout Calgary and the surrounding area. For  families choosing <a href="/en-ca/cremation/planning-a-cremation">cremation</a>, we have an on-site crematorium. </p>
<h2>
The Foster's team celebrates life
</h2>
<p>
<img src="data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAAAACH5BAEKAAEALAAAAAABAAEAAAICTAEAOw==" alt="Sitting area at Foster's Garden Chapel & Crematorium" style="width: 280px; height: 140px; float: left;" data-src="/dfsmedia/042808e1630c49a48950d5077d6556eb/3134-50067/3600-sitting-area-1-jpg">We pride ourselves on having compassionate and sincere associates who embody a deep commitment to caring. They are experienced in serving people of many faiths, cultures and backgrounds.</p>
<p>
We've adapted to the diverse needs and wants of the community when it comes to funerals and celebration of life services. Though many families choose <a href="/en-ca/memorial-services/planning-a-funeral/traditional-funeral">traditional funeral services</a>, the team also offers contemporary options and <a href="/en-ca/memorial-services/planning-a-celebration-of-life/celebration-of-life">personalized services</a>.
</p>
<p>If desired, our Dignity Memorial® celebrant will visit with your family, discover the story of your loved one and create a ceremony that beautifully incorporates their hobbies, passions and spirit. The creative possibilities are endless.</p>
<h2> Asian services and burning room </h2>
<p> Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium is specially equipped for services for Asian and Buddhist families. A room with a fireplace is conveniently located adjacent to our chapel to accommodate traditional burning ceremonies with the maximum safety and comfort.</p>
<p> Our team has extensive experience in planning ceremonies according to Chinese traditions as well. Even for Canadians who are 2nd- and 3rd-generation Chinese, we can offer guidance in traditional customs. If your family members speak only Chinese, let us know and we can bring in someone who speaks fluent Chinese. </p>
<h2> Community involvement and events</h2>
<p> <img src="data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAAAACH5BAEKAAEALAAAAAABAAEAAAICTAEAOw==" alt="Reception room at Foster's Garden Chapel & Crematorium" style="width: 280px; height: 140px; float: right;" data-src="/dfsmedia/042808e1630c49a48950d5077d6556eb/3132-50067/3600-reception-room-2-jpg">At Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium, we are committed to helping others and  take great pride in giving back to our community. Every year we host our Easter Egg Hunt, Children’s Costume Party and Stampede Barbeque. We support local charities through our annual Charity Garage Sale as well as other events.</p>
<p>We also take great pride in offering our annual Christmas Candlelight Memorial Service to  families we have served throughout the year and anyone in the community who wishes to attend.</p>
<h2>Here for you</h2>
<p>Whether you need <a href="/en-ca/immediate-need">immediate assistance</a> or would like to know more about our services, please contact us. At Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium, we are here for you. </p>
<h2>History
</h2>
<p>
<img src="data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAAAACH5BAEKAAEALAAAAAABAAEAAAICTAEAOw==" alt="Front exterior building at Foster's Garden Chapel & Crematorium" style="width: 280px; height: 140px; float: left;" data-src="/dfsmedia/042808e1630c49a48950d5077d6556eb/3129-50067/3600-front-exterior-2-jpg">The founder of what is now Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium was Cy Foster. He opened his original funeral home on 16th Avenue Northwest in Calgary, under the name Foster’s Garden Chapel on a freezing December 3, 1956. He had 7 calls that first month, 15 the next and 300 by the end of the first year.
</p>
<h3>
The funeral home business grows
</h3>
<p>
Over the years, Cy partnered with the Gooder Brothers to open 2 other funeral homes: Cy Foster-Gooder’s Chapel on the Hill (located at 1708 16th Ave. NW) and Cy Foster-Gooder Hillside Chapel (located at 1635 17th Ave. SW).
</p>
<p>
In the 1980s, Foster's decided to open a new funeral home that would be an amalgamation of the 3 original funeral homes. Construction at our present location, across from Queen’s Park Cemetery, began in 1988. The new Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium opened on July 27, 1989.
</p>
<h3>
Upholding a tradition
</h3>
<p>
Though it’s been decades since Cy opened his first funeral home, the team at Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium upholds his commitment to helping families through the emotional challenges of planning funerals, cremations and burials.
</p>                                    <div>

<script>

        Handlebars.registerHelper('formatRating', function (ratingsNumber) {
            return generateRatings(ratingsNumber);

        Handlebars.registerHelper("getPercentage", function (startCount, totalCount) {

            var percentage = 100 * startCount / totalCount;
            return percentage.toFixed();

        });

        Handlebars.registerHelper('filterByRating', function (reviews, minRating, options) {
            const filtered = reviews.filter(review => review.FuneralOverallRating >= minRating);
            return options.fn({ Reviews: filtered });
        });

        Handlebars.registerHelper('formatFullDate', function (dateString) {
            return new Handlebars.SafeString(
                moment(dateString).locale(currentLanguage).format("MMMM YYYY")
            );
        });

        Handlebars.registerHelper('iff', function (a, operator, b, opts) {
            var bool = false;
            switch (operator) {
                case '==':
                    bool = a == b;
                    break;
                case '>':
                    bool = a > b;
                    break;
                case '<':
                    bool = a < b;
                    break;
                default:
                    throw "Unknown operator " + operator;
            }

            if (bool) {
                return opts.fn(this);
            } else {
                return opts.inverse(this);
            }
        });
    });
</script>

                    {{/with}}
                    {{/ifOr}}
                    {{/ifOr}}

    {{/if}}

    var locale = 'en-CA';

    $(function () {
        Handlebars.registerHelper('ifEquals', function (arg1, arg2, options) {
            return (arg1 === arg2) ? options.fn(this) : options.inverse(this);
        });

        Handlebars.registerHelper('ifNotEquals', function (arg1, arg2, options) {
            return (arg1 != arg2) ? options.fn(this) : options.inverse(this);
        });

        Handlebars.registerHelper('parsePrice', function (arg1) {
            return parseInt(arg1).toLocaleString(locale);
        });

        Handlebars.registerHelper('lcase', function (arg1) {
            return arg1.toLowerCase();
        });

        Handlebars.registerHelper('parseId', function (arg1) {
            return arg1.replace(/^[^a-zA-Z]+|[^\w:.-]+/g, "");
        });

        Handlebars.registerHelper('ifOr', function (arg1, arg2, options) {
            arg1 = Array.isArray(arg1) ? arg1.length : arg1;
            arg2 = Array.isArray(arg2) ? arg2.length : arg2;

            return (arg1 || arg2) ? options.fn(this) : options.inverse(this);
        });

        Handlebars.registerHelper('ifAnd', function (arg1, arg2, options) {
            arg1 = Array.isArray(arg1) ? arg1.length : arg1;
            arg2 = Array.isArray(arg2) ? arg2.length : arg2;

            return (arg1 && arg2) ? options.fn(this) : options.inverse(this);
        });
    });
</script>

About
Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium provides funeral, cremation and memorial services in Calgary and surrounding areas.
Chapel at Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium
Located on 4th Street Northwest, the funeral home is just a 20-minute drive from Calgary International Airport, with a public transit stop near our front entrance. The chapel's exit leading to our climate-controlled concourse provides comfortable funeral vehicle access throughout the year. The entire building is wheelchair accessible.
The chapel and fireside lounge
Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium has a distinctly warm and comforting environment. Our 23,500-square-foot Tudor-style building includes one of the larger funeral chapels in Calgary. It seats 250 people and has lovely 16-foot stained-glass windows that span floor to ceiling. The chapel features oak pews and a cathedral-style ceiling, creating excellent acoustics. Families have a choice of organ or digital grand piano for musical accompaniment.
Whether gathering for visitations, as a family before a service or for a reception, our fireside lounge is a warm, comfortable place to meet. Central to the room is a floor-to-ceiling fieldstone fireplace.
On-site crematory and convenient cemetery
Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium is located directly across from Queen’s Park Cemetery. We’re experienced at coordinating burial needs with this cemetery and others throughout Calgary and the surrounding area. For  families choosing
cremation
, we have an on-site crematorium.
The Foster's team celebrates life
We pride ourselves on having compassionate and sincere associates who embody a deep commitment to caring. They are experienced in serving people of many faiths, cultures and backgrounds.
We've adapted to the diverse needs and wants of the community when it comes to funerals and celebration of life services. Though many families choose
traditional funeral services
, the team also offers contemporary options and
personalized services
.
If desired, our Dignity Memorial® celebrant will visit with your family, discover the story of your loved one and create a ceremony that beautifully incorporates their hobbies, passions and spirit. The creative possibilities are endless.
Asian services and burning room
Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium is specially equipped for services for Asian and Buddhist families. A room with a fireplace is conveniently located adjacent to our chapel to accommodate traditional burning ceremonies with the maximum safety and comfort.
Our team has extensive experience in planning ceremonies according to Chinese traditions as well. Even for Canadians who are 2nd- and 3rd-generation Chinese, we can offer guidance in traditional customs. If your family members speak only Chinese, let us know and we can bring in someone who speaks fluent Chinese.
Community involvement and events
At Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium, we are committed to helping others and  take great pride in giving back to our community. Every year we host our Easter Egg Hunt, Children’s Costume Party and Stampede Barbeque. We support local charities through our annual Charity Garage Sale as well as other events.
We also take great pride in offering our annual Christmas Candlelight Memorial Service to  families we have served throughout the year and anyone in the community who wishes to attend.
Here for you
Whether you need
immediate assistance
or would like to know more about our services, please contact us. At Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium, we are here for you.
History
The founder of what is now Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium was Cy Foster. He opened his original funeral home on 16th Avenue Northwest in Calgary, under the name Foster’s Garden Chapel on a freezing December 3, 1956. He had 7 calls that first month, 15 the next and 300 by the end of the first year.
The funeral home business grows
Over the years, Cy partnered with the Gooder Brothers to open 2 other funeral homes: Cy Foster-Gooder’s Chapel on the Hill (located at 1708 16th Ave. NW) and Cy Foster-Gooder Hillside Chapel (located at 1635 17th Ave. SW).
In the 1980s, Foster's decided to open a new funeral home that would be an amalgamation of the 3 original funeral homes. Construction at our present location, across from Queen’s Park Cemetery, began in 1988. The new Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium opened on July 27, 1989.
Upholding a tradition
Though it’s been decades since Cy opened his first funeral home, the team at Foster's Garden Chapel Funeral Home & Crematorium upholds his commitment to helping families through the emotional challenges of planning funerals, cremations and burials.

Together in Healing is a monthly grief support and education group offering a welcoming space to connect, learn, and better understand the many experiences of grief. Each session explores a different topic and provides practical information, support, and tools for navigating life after loss.Monthly sessions resume this September.

At Oliver’s, our experience in all facets of funeral service means we’re ready to handle every detail for you with compassion and understanding. What Families Say About Oliver's
Erin, Peter, and Molly MacLellan
Tracy, Chris, and the staff at Oliver’s, we can’t thank you enough for your thoughtful and tender care of our family as we navigated Kara’s memorial. It was such a blessing to have a team of people behind us working and praying for our family to make a very difficult day special and meaningful. You listened to everything we said, and we felt very supported through every decision. You have a challenging career, but everyone behaved with such grace and professionalism.
Janice
Wow! I received the urn this morning and it is absolutely perfect! It is even more beautiful than the picture and is exactly what we were looking for. After looking at hundred of urns, I am so extremely grateful and blessed that I chose your company to assist me in purchasing our mother’s urn. The service you provided was exceptional! Your professionalism and communication were amazing and left no questions unanswered! The urn arrived quickly and was very well packed and protected! I will be highly recommending Oliver’s to all in the future. Thank you again from the bottom of ...
Dawn
The assistance we received in aftercare made the situating easer and would cause us to recommend Oliver’s to anybody.
Mona Rowland
At a time when people are emotional, the staff are very patient and don’t get frustrated when things have to be repeated. Very thoughtful, compassionate, and efficient.
Donald LeGoffe
I had the recent pleasure of dealing with Craig McFee. I wanted to reserve a plot in the Grande Prairie Cemetery and, as I live on the opposite side of the province, needed to make the purchase during a recent visit to Grande Prairie. In short order, the purchase was made without a hitch. Thank you, Craig, for helping me out. Your efforts are greatly appreciated.
The Testawitch Family
The family of Rita Testawitch thank you for helping us take care of all the funeral arrangements and taking such great care of Grandma. Your kindness is deeply appreciated and will be remembered always.
Colin and Gisele Wilson
What blew me away was when one of the pallbearers showed up with muddy shoes and your staff were so non-judgemental, commenting not to worry, took his shoes and cleaned them up for us. To me, this meant a lot, providing service above and beyond. All the details were organised and looked after for us, making things easy, as we wouldn’t have even known where to start. The day of the service was excellent and the staff showed friendliness and professionalism. We were truly impressed! Our entire experience with Oliver’s met and exceed all our expectations. We are so grateful ...
The McDermotts, The Zaharas, and the McKims
We are so grateful for you compassion, kindness, and tender care of our daughter, sister, mother, and wife, Natalie McDermott. You have guided us through this process in such a gentle way. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts!
Shane and Michele Gale
Chris and Staff, we would like to thank you for all you did for Wyatt’s Celebration of Life and beyond. It was a beautiful service and your help and support meant so much to us.
Ann
Dear Amazing Oliver’s Staff, Thank you for the amazing evening. Dr. Bill Webster’s Grief Journey was so helpful and healing. Blessings
April Melnick
Dear Tracy, Thank you so much for all the paperwork, and phone calls done for me. Your efforts were and are appreciated so very much. Really made things go much easier during all our turmoil at the time.
Jack Janzen
We like the way Oliver’s pays attention to all the little details. We did not have to worry about anything. They just take care of things, right down to the canceling of personal cards (driver’s licence, credit cards, etc.). Gene is very professional at his work, but more than that is the way he comes alongside people with a genuine concern for where they are at.

Together in Healing
Together in Healing is a monthly grief support and education group offering a welcoming space to connect, learn, and better understand the many experiences of grief. Each session explores a different topic and provides practical information, support, and tools for navigating life after loss.Monthly sessions resume this September.
For More Information
Serving Grande Prairie And Area For Over 110 Years.
We have everything you might need.
At Oliver’s, our experience in all facets of funeral service means we’re ready to handle every detail for you with compassion and understanding. Throughout our history, Oliver’s Funeral Home has been perfecting traditions while also innovating to create new ways to enhance and personalize how families celebrate the lives of their loved ones.

What Families Say About Oliver's
Erin, Peter, and Molly MacLellan
Tracy, Chris, and the staff at Oliver’s, we can’t thank you enough for your thoughtful and tender care of our family as we navigated Kara’s memorial. It was such a blessing to have a team of people behind us working and praying for our family to make a very difficult day special and meaningful. You listened to everything we said, and we felt very supported through every decision. You have a challenging career, but everyone behaved with such grace and professionalism.
Janice
Wow! I received the urn this morning and it is absolutely perfect! It is even more beautiful than the picture and is exactly what we were looking for. After looking at hundred of urns, I am so extremely grateful and blessed that I chose your company to assist me in purchasing our mother’s urn. The service you provided was exceptional! Your professionalism and communication were amazing and left no questions unanswered! The urn arrived quickly and was very well packed and protected! I will be highly recommending Oliver’s to all in the future. Thank you again from the bottom of ...
Dawn
The assistance we received in aftercare made the situating easer and would cause us to recommend Oliver’s to anybody.
Mona Rowland
At a time when people are emotional, the staff are very patient and don’t get frustrated when things have to be repeated. Very thoughtful, compassionate, and efficient.
Donald LeGoffe
I had the recent pleasure of dealing with Craig McFee. I wanted to reserve a plot in the Grande Prairie Cemetery and, as I live on the opposite side of the province, needed to make the purchase during a recent visit to Grande Prairie. In short order, the purchase was made without a hitch. Thank you, Craig, for helping me out. Your efforts are greatly appreciated.
The Testawitch Family
The family of Rita Testawitch thank you for helping us take care of all the funeral arrangements and taking such great care of Grandma. Your kindness is deeply appreciated and will be remembered always.
Colin and Gisele Wilson
What blew me away was when one of the pallbearers showed up with muddy shoes and your staff were so non-judgemental, commenting not to worry, took his shoes and cleaned them up for us. To me, this meant a lot, providing service above and beyond. All the details were organised and looked after for us, making things easy, as we wouldn’t have even known where to start. The day of the service was excellent and the staff showed friendliness and professionalism. We were truly impressed! Our entire experience with Oliver’s met and exceed all our expectations. We are so grateful ...
The McDermotts, The Zaharas, and the McKims
We are so grateful for you compassion, kindness, and tender care of our daughter, sister, mother, and wife, Natalie McDermott. You have guided us through this process in such a gentle way. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts!
Shane and Michele Gale
Chris and Staff, we would like to thank you for all you did for Wyatt’s Celebration of Life and beyond. It was a beautiful service and your help and support meant so much to us.
Ann
Dear Amazing Oliver’s Staff, Thank you for the amazing evening. Dr. Bill Webster’s Grief Journey was so helpful and healing. Blessings
April Melnick
Dear Tracy, Thank you so much for all the paperwork, and phone calls done for me. Your efforts were and are appreciated so very much. Really made things go much easier during all our turmoil at the time.
Jack Janzen
We like the way Oliver’s pays attention to all the little details. We did not have to worry about anything. They just take care of things, right down to the canceling of personal cards (driver’s licence, credit cards, etc.). Gene is very professional at his work, but more than that is the way he comes alongside people with a genuine concern for where they are at.

In Loving Memory Of David Hagerman
1951-2022
We are deeply saddened to announce the passing of one of our own. David Hagerman worked for Oliver’s for the past 4 years until his retirement in October 2021. Even though he had retired he would still be found around the funeral home quite often. He was a wonderful, kind, caring man who was always willing to lend a hand wherever needed. His craftsmanship can be found throughout our facilities. He left us with so many great stories and memories that we will cherish forever. We have found comfort knowing that you are now with your Lord. You will be greatly missed.
~ Chris, Tracy, Craig, and all of your family at Oliver’s Funeral Home

In Loving Memory Of David Hagerman
1951-2022
We are deeply saddened to announce the passing of one of our own. David Hagerman worked for Oliver’s for the past 4 years until his retirement in October 2021. Even though he had retired he would still be found around the funeral home quite often. He was a wonderful, kind, caring man who was always willing to lend a hand wherever needed. His craftsmanship can be found throughout our facilities. He left us with so many great stories and memories that we will cherish forever. We have found comfort knowing that you are now with your Lord. You will be greatly missed.
~ Chris, Tracy, Craig, and all of your family at Oliver’s Funeral Home

About
At Parkland Funeral Services, we provide funeral and cremation services to families in Stony Plain, Alberta, and the surrounding areas. Whether you have an
immediate need
for our services or wish to
make final arrangements in advance
, our experienced funeral professionals will help guide you through the
funeral planning process
.
Let's start with a story
Every person deserves to be celebrated in a unique way. At Parkland Funeral Services, our caring and compassionate associates craft unique and meaningful memorials that celebrate a loved one's passions, personality and individuality. We can find inspiration almost anywhere. Our team takes all of the things that a person loved, such as a treasured poem, a lifelong hobby or even a favourite colour, and strings them together to create a heartfelt tribute like no other. From music and flowers to keepsakes and catering, we'll take care of all the details—no matter how big or small.
Welcoming funeral home
In addition to its colourful murals, Stony Plain is known for its multicultural population. We embrace our diverse community and proudly serve families of all cultures, religions and backgrounds. Our team is familiar with a wide range of funeral customs and rites and is committed to honouring your family's traditions.
You can count on us
As a member of the Dignity Memorial
®
network, Parkland Funeral Services provides the warm and compassionate care you can expect from a locally operated establishment as well as the value you deserve from North America's largest network of funeral, cremation and cemetery service providers.
Please call us for any reason at all. We're here for you day and night.

Remembrance
“Every detail remembered” is more than a tagline. It’s how we do everything, including offering meaningful ways to honor and remember a loved one.
Learn More
Online memorial
More than an obituary, our free online memorial allows you to share service details and invite family and friends to contribute photos, videos and fond memories.
Keepsake program
Many who attend a celebration of life keep the program. A tangible representation of a loving memory, it may include an obituary, photos, poems and more.
Tribute movie
A video of cherished photos helps tell a special story. We play it during the celebration and then give it to you to play again and again, as often as you’d like.
Memory book
A collection of images and heartfelt messages from family and friends captures the essence of a loved one’s life in a book future generations will cherish.

            <div class="hide-extra-paragraphs hide-extra-sections">
                <div class="about-description">
<p> At Parkland Funeral Services, we provide funeral and cremation services to families in Stony Plain, Alberta, and the surrounding areas. Whether you have an <a href="/en-ca/immediate-need">immediate need</a> for our services or wish to <a href="/en-ca/pre-need">make final arrangements in advance</a>, our experienced funeral professionals will help guide you through the <a href="/en-ca/plan-funeral-cremation">funeral planning process</a>.</p>                </div>
<h2>
Let's start with a story</h2>
<p>Every person deserves to be celebrated in a unique way. At Parkland Funeral Services, our caring and compassionate associates craft unique and meaningful memorials that celebrate a loved one's passions, personality and individuality. We can find inspiration almost anywhere. Our team takes all of the things that a person loved, such as a treasured poem, a lifelong hobby or even a favourite colour, and strings them together to create a heartfelt tribute like no other. From music and flowers to keepsakes and catering, we'll take care of all the details—no matter how big or small. </p>
<h2>Welcoming funeral home</h2>
<p><img data-src="/dfsmedia/042808e1630c49a48950d5077d6556eb/51790-50067/" style="width: 280px; height: 140px; float: left;" />In addition to its colourful murals, Stony Plain is known for its multicultural population. We embrace our diverse community and proudly serve families of all cultures, religions and backgrounds. Our team is familiar with a wide range of funeral customs and rites and is committed to honouring your family's traditions.</p>
<h2>You can count on us</h2>
<p>As a member of the Dignity Memorial<sup>®</sup> network, Parkland Funeral Services provides the warm and compassionate care you can expect from a locally operated establishment as well as the value you deserve from North America's largest network of funeral, cremation and cemetery service providers.</p>
<p>Please call us for any reason at all. We're here for you day and night. </p>                                    <div>

<script>
    var currentLanguage = 'en-ca';

    $(function () {
        Handlebars.registerHelper('formatRating', function (ratingsNumber) {
            return generateRatings(ratingsNumber);
        });
        Handlebars.registerHelper("getPercentage", function (startCount, totalCount) {

            var percentage = 100 * startCount / totalCount;
            return percentage.toFixed();

        });

        Handlebars.registerHelper('filterByRating', function (reviews, minRating, options) {
            const filtered = reviews.filter(review => review.FuneralOverallRating >= minRating);
            return options.fn({ Reviews: filtered });
        });

        Handlebars.registerHelper('formatFullDate', function (dateString) {
            return new Handlebars.SafeString(
                moment(dateString).locale(currentLanguage).format("MMMM YYYY")
            );
        });

        Handlebars.registerHelper('iff', function (a, operator, b, opts) {
            var bool = false;
            switch (operator) {
                case '==':
                    bool = a == b;
                    break;
                case '>':
                    bool = a > b;
                    break;
                case '<':
                    bool = a < b;
                    break;
                default:
                    throw "Unknown operator " + operator;
            }

            if (bool) {
                return opts.fn(this);
            } else {
                return opts.inverse(this);
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script type="text/x-handlebars-template" id="pricing-carousel-template">
    {{#if Cards}}
    <div class="component carousel carousel-multiple-items carousel-show-dots carousel-pricing">
        {{#each Cards}}
        {{#if Code}}
        {{#if ShowPrice}}
        {{#if Price}}
        <div class="component surfaced-item surfaced-item-vertical regular-card">
            <div class="pricing-card-container">
                <div class="pricing-card-photo lazy" data-bg="{{Image.Url}}">
                    {{#if ImageDisclaimerText}}
                    <div class="disclaimer-overlay">
                        <p class="disclaimer-overlay-text">{{ImageDisclaimerText}}</p>
                    </div>
                    {{/if}}

                    {{#ifOr ShowMediaCarousel ShowTourCarousel}}
                    {{#ifOr MediaCarouselImages Tour360CarouselImages}}
                    {{#with CtaAction}}
                    {{#ifEquals Anchor "#overlay-photo"}}
                    <a class="view-pricing-gallery view-details gtm-{{../SanitizedCode}}-view-pricing-gallery" data-toggle="modal" data-loc-id="{{LocationId}}" data-card-type="{{../SanitizedCode}}" data-target="#overlay-{{#parseId ../SanitizedCode}}{{/parseId}}" tabindex="0"><span>{{Text}}</span></a>
                    {{/ifEquals}}
                    {{/with}}
                    {{/ifOr}}
                    {{/ifOr}}
                </div>

                <div class="pricing-data-container">
                    <h3>{{Title}}</h3>

                    {{#if Subtitle}}
                    <div class="pricing-guests">
                        {{#with ../SecondaryIcon}}
                        <img src="data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAAAACH5BAEKAAEALAAAAAABAAEAAAICTAEAOw==" data-src="{{Url}}" alt="{{Description}}" class="pricing-subtitle-icon" />
                        {{/with}}
                        <span>{{Subtitle}}</span>

                    </div>
                    {{/if}}

                    <p>{{Description}}</p>
                </div>

                <div class="pricing-data-footer">
                    {{#if ShowCustomQuote}}
                        <a class="{{CustomQuoteCssClass}} custom-quote" data-toggle="modal" data-target="{{CustomQuoteDataTarget}}">{{CustomQuoteText}}</a>
                    {{else}}
                        <div class="pricing-value-start">
                            <span class="starting-at">{{PricingLabel}}</span>
                            <span class="price">{{#parsePrice Price}}{{/parsePrice}}</span>
                        </div>
                    {{/if}}

                    {{#with CtaAction}}
                    {{#ifEquals Anchor "#overlay"}}
                    <div class="pricing-cta">
                        <a class="{{CssClass}} view-details gtm-{{../SanitizedCode}}-view-details" data-loc-id="{{LocationId}}" data-card-type="{{../SanitizedCode}}" data-toggle="modal" data-target="#overlay-{{#parseId ../SanitizedCode}}{{/parseId}}" tabindex="0"><span>{{Text}}</span></a>
                    </div>
                    {{else}}
                    {{#ifNotEquals Anchor "#overlay-photo"}}
                    <div class="pricing-cta">
                        <a class="{{CssClass}} gtm-{{../SanitizedCode}}-view-link" {{#if Target}} target="{{Target}}" {{/if}} href="{{Url}}"><span>{{Text}}</span></a>
                    </div>
                    {{/ifNotEquals}}
                    {{/ifEquals}}
                    {{/with}}
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        {{/if}}
        {{/if}}
        {{/if}}
        {{/each}}
    </div>
    {{/if}}
</script>
<script>
    var locale = 'en-CA';

    $(function () {
        Handlebars.registerHelper('ifEquals', function (arg1, arg2, options) {
            return (arg1 === arg2) ? options.fn(this) : options.inverse(this);
        });

        Handlebars.registerHelper('ifNotEquals', function (arg1, arg2, options) {
            return (arg1 != arg2) ? options.fn(this) : options.inverse(this);
        });

        Handlebars.registerHelper('parsePrice', function (arg1) {
            return parseInt(arg1).toLocaleString(locale);
        });

        Handlebars.registerHelper('lcase', function (arg1) {
            return arg1.toLowerCase();
        });

        Handlebars.registerHelper('parseId', function (arg1) {
            return arg1.replace(/^[^a-zA-Z]+|[^\w:.-]+/g, "");
        });

        Handlebars.registerHelper('ifOr', function (arg1, arg2, options) {
            arg1 = Array.isArray(arg1) ? arg1.length : arg1;
            arg2 = Array.isArray(arg2) ? arg2.length : arg2;

            return (arg1 || arg2) ? options.fn(this) : options.inverse(this);
        });

        Handlebars.registerHelper('ifAnd', function (arg1, arg2, options) {
            arg1 = Array.isArray(arg1) ? arg1.length : arg1;
            arg2 = Array.isArray(arg2) ? arg2.length : arg2;

            return (arg1 && arg2) ? options.fn(this) : options.inverse(this);
        });
    });
</script>

About
At Parkland Funeral Services, we provide funeral and cremation services to families in Stony Plain, Alberta, and the surrounding areas. Whether you have an
immediate need
for our services or wish to
make final arrangements in advance
, our experienced funeral professionals will help guide you through the
funeral planning process
.
Let's start with a story
Every person deserves to be celebrated in a unique way. At Parkland Funeral Services, our caring and compassionate associates craft unique and meaningful memorials that celebrate a loved one's passions, personality and individuality. We can find inspiration almost anywhere. Our team takes all of the things that a person loved, such as a treasured poem, a lifelong hobby or even a favourite colour, and strings them together to create a heartfelt tribute like no other. From music and flowers to keepsakes and catering, we'll take care of all the details—no matter how big or small.
Welcoming funeral home
In addition to its colourful murals, Stony Plain is known for its multicultural population. We embrace our diverse community and proudly serve families of all cultures, religions and backgrounds. Our team is familiar with a wide range of funeral customs and rites and is committed to honouring your family's traditions.
You can count on us
As a member of the Dignity Memorial
®
network, Parkland Funeral Services provides the warm and compassionate care you can expect from a locally operated establishment as well as the value you deserve from North America's largest network of funeral, cremation and cemetery service providers.
Please call us for any reason at all. We're here for you day and night.
